# dvls_user (Data Source)

A DVLS user. Application accounts are exposed by `dvls_application` instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup by ID
data "dvls_user" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

# Lookup by login name
data "dvls_user" "by_name" {
  name = "jdoe"
}

# Lookup by display name
data "dvls_user" "by_full_name" {
  full_name = "John Doe"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `full_name` (String) The display name of the user. Exactly one of `id`, `name` or `full_name` must be set.
- `id` (String) The ID of the user. Exactly one of `id`, `name` or `full_name` must be set.
- `name` (String) The login name of the user. Exactly one of `id`, `name` or `full_name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `authentication_type` (String) How the user authenticates. Possible values are [application, azure_ad, builtin, cloud, contractor, domain, legacy, local_windows, none, office_365, okta, ping_one, sql_server].
- `email` (String) The email address of the user.
- `is_administrator` (Boolean) Whether the user is a DVLS administrator.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is enabled.
- `user_groups` (Set of String) IDs of the user groups the user belongs to.
